status.summary: Daily check 15 Nov: No new 2027 rules found today. Still no 2027 rules: GRENKE (site still 2026), Czech Open, Teplice, Polanica, Biel (only dates 10–23 July 2027), Vienna, St Veit, Faaker See, Tenkes, Cap d'Agde (capechecs.com/2027 still shows the 2026 text), Menton, Cannes (only festival dates), Ghent, Sants, Forni, Spilimbergo, Trieste, Tsaghkadzor, Fagernes autumn, European Ch. (venue not confirmed); Riga 14–20 Dec still has no rules. Mont-de-Marsan 26–30 Dec: hall is the Auberge Landaise (Landes tourism page); fee, prizes and time control still not published. Player lists: Rilton 115 (was 114), Groningen 93 (was 92), Sevilla 70 (was 68), Reykjavik 60 (was 59); unchanged and re-checked today: Bali 190, Roma 106, Wroclaw 106 (one player listed twice), Vardaris 87, Menorca 81, Pamplona 52, Bad Wörishofen 50, Graz 42, Hastings 42, Goris 41, Palmanova 39, Lienz 26, Bled 24, Kufstein 13, Prague Open A 12, Prague Festival D 12, Wien Advent 11, Marienbad IM group 6, Faaker See 3, Nový Bor 2, Tenkes 1. Sligo list still empty; Cracovia (chessmanager) still unreadable. Prague Open: Open A (IM open) is the top group — other groups are B, C, rapid, blitz. Marienbad: groups are A GM RR, B IM RR, C FIDE Open (tnr1446845, 6 players so far, 16–23 Jan). Prague Festival: only D, E and F groups on chess-results so far. No player-list pages yet for Yerevan Open, Cannes, Mont-de-Marsan, Pilsen, Cappelle, Malakoff, Jersey. Armenia: Goris Open 21–28 Nov; Men's First League 12–23 Dec, Women's 15–23 Dec; no new Yerevan Open news. France: chess-calendar.eu now refuses robots (robots.txt), so its month pages could not be read today; no new strong French opens found by web search beyond those listed 13–14 Nov. Flights not checked here (separate task). Flights 15 Nov: not checked — Skyscanner, Kiwi.com and Google Flights all refused automated access today, so flight prices stay as last checked (mostly 8 Nov).
